page0.text:
"Ungh... Haah..."
I feel dizzy.
My body can't hold out any longer.
...I'm going to die.
I can't endure it in the very end.
Then, if I can't endure it anyway, should I loosen up?
If I do so, I should at least be able to push him back into that void...

page1.text:
"No, don't underestimate me...! I won't let you take me with you...!"
I re-energize my weakening limbs.
Will my arm tear off first, will his chain rip off first, or will he crawl out first?
It doesn't matter. I'll fight until the very end and die a flashy death...!

page2.text: "...Heh. You can do as you wish, but dodge to the right before that."

page3.text:
"Huh?"
I turn around immediately.
I look at the temple grounds in the distance, which has become a wasteland.
Something flies by, as if brushing past me.

page4.text:
"You... Ar...cher..."
...The chain comes off.
In the end...
Looking like he saw something unexpected, he lets go of the Chain of the Heavens.

page5.text:
...
I fall on my butt.
The void shrinks to the size of my palm and vanishes as I look on, dumbfounded.

page6.text:
"That... was..."
Unable to even stand, I look at the wasteland behind me.
Dawn is near.
The one with the rising sun behind him is the knight wearing a red cloak.

page7.text:
"What a... show-off."
I subconsciously complain.
But, I can't help but smile happily.

page8.text:
"...Heh. Well..."
I have nothing I want to say, so I'll keep quiet so that I can sleep.

page9.text:
The golden ground that became a wasteland.
Seeing the knight stand there and Tohsaka running to him, I lie down on the ground.
Tohsaka should say everything I want to say to him on my behalf.

page10.text:
So, I'll sleep for now.
I'm sure we'll end up fighting if we see each other again, and I'm not used to saying farewell to myself.

page11.text:
...And for the final time...
I engrave my ideal into my mind so that I won't forget it and slowly close my eyes.

page12.text:
The ground that he stands on is similar to the wasteland that I saw before.
There is nothing around.
There is nothing extra on this summit where everything was blown away.
The battle has ended.

page13.text:
The battle for the Holy Grail has ended, and the curtain is about to fall on his battle as well.
He does not know how long it was.
But the accumulated wish that should have bound him forever is gone now.
The end quickly permeates into him and melts this era's version of his body.

page14.text:
"Archer...!"
He looks towards the voice calling him.
That girl must not have the spare energy to run, but she runs to him, breathing unsteadily.
He quietly watches her.

page15.text:
"Haah, haah, haah, haah...!"
The girl that ran up to him looks up at the knight, still breathing unsteadily.

page16.text:
The red cloak flowing in the wind shows no trace of what it used to be.
It is torn everywhere, and his armor is cracked and broken.
His existence is weak.
The knight that stands still with haughtiness, just like the time they first met, starts to disappear from his feet up.

page17.text:
"Ar...cher..."
Dawn approaches in the distance.
The golden sun rises faintly from the horizon.

page18.text:
"Too bad. Well, that's what happened. Give up the Holy Grail this time, Rin."
Does he not have anything special to say?
The red knight says a trivial thing like that.

page19.text:
...
That gets the girl all the more.
With that body that was about to disappear, the knight was the same knight as before.
An ally that she trusted and ran through the night with, who had her back while making sarcastic remarks.
She can declare that those memories were fun, looking back at them.

page20.text:
And they are still in front of her, unchanged.
He remained to save her at the last moment.
He lost his Master and withstood the Noble Phantasm of the King of Heroes.
His body was disappearing, but he didn't ask for her help and watched over their battle.
That end is in front of her.

page21.text:
"Archer."
The girl can't think of what she should say.
It is always like that for her at the most crucial times.
She loses her quick-wittedness when she needs it the most.

page22.text:
"Ha..."
The knight smiles slightly.
He knew that from the start.
The girl's clumsiness is a memory more fond than anything to the knight in red.

page23.text:
"...W-What? Now's not the time to be laughing!"
She looks up at the knight, annoyed.
"Oh, sorry. It's just the way you looked.
I was just stunned at how worn out we both look."
He still has a smile even as he banters.

page24.text:
...
She gets a lump in her throat from seeing his face free of regrets.
She wonders if it's okay.
The moment she wonders if it's okay for him to disappear like this...
"Archer. Form a contract with me again."
She says those words that she shouldn't say.

page25.text:
"I cannot do that. I do not know if you plan to continue your contract with Saber, but I do not have the right to.
And I have no objective anymore. My battle ends here."
His answer has no doubt, and his will is pure.
His face is as bright as the sunrise, and how can she force him when he's making a face like that?

page26.text:
"...But! But, then.
You will never..."
...Be saved.
The girl swallows her words and looks down.
That is not something the girl should say and it wouldn't be granted even if she kept the knight in this world.

page27.text:
"...I'm troubled. I don't have any attachments to this world, but..."
It's troubling to have this girl cry.
For him, the girl always has to be positive, realistic, and indulgent.
He was always encouraged by her.
That's why he wanted this girl to be her usual self until the very end.

page28.text:
"...Rin."
The girl looks up at the sound of his voice.
Her face trying to hold back her tears is adorable.
Rather than expressing the slight attachment that he feels, he looks at the collapsed boy in the distance.
"Please take care of me. I am an unreliable guy, as you know.
Please support me."
The knight says objectively.

page29.text:
Those are words of farewell.
...The future might change.
If a girl like her stays by Shirou Emiya's side, then the hero named Emiya will not be born.
His distant words contain such hope.

page30.text:
"...Ar...cher."
...But, even if that were to happen, even then... The knight in red that already exists will forever be a Guardian.
He and the boy are different existences.
They only have the same starting point, and he was an illusion that the boy dreamt of.

page31.text:
"...Oh."
...There is no salvation available for this knight anymore.
There is nothing to give to him, as he has already died and become a phenomenon.
The girl nods in spite of that.
Because she cannot give him anything, she gives him the biggest smile in the end.
He asks her to take care of him.
In order to answer the trust that he put in her...
"Yeah, I know. I'll do my best. I'll do my best so he won't become twisted like you. I'll do my best so that he'll be able to like himself...!
So, you should also..."
Forgive yourself.
She doesn't put it into words.
The girl looks up at the disappearing knight with a flood of emotions.

page32.text:
How much salvation did that bring?
After engraving the girl's smile into his memory with pride...

page33.text: "I got my answer. It's all right, Tohsaka. I'll do my best from now on too."

page34.text:
A breeze.
The knight finally rests his wounded body, without waiting for the girl's reply.

page35.text:
"...Humph. I didn't get to complain to you after all."
She wipes her tears as they well up and says to the man who is no longer there.
That voice is invigorated, and she regains her usual stoutheartedness.
It is only natural.
She doesn't have the time to be down after he made a face like that.
She says farewell to the wasteland where the knight stood, and the girl runs down to the collapsed boy.
